Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 142. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 25 per ki blast
Prerequisites: 1 star in Missle Barrage
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 30 feet
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Barrage
Fire a barrage of individual Powerful ki blasts up to
but not exceeding your proficiency bonus. Roll a
Barrage Attack Roll dealing your Basic Ki Blast
Damage Die + 2d12 ki damage on a hit for each ki blast.
